Night: moon key 0.95 -> 1.35, ambient 0.26 -> 0.16, sky contribution 0.2 -> 0.08, so props cast a readable shadow. Golden and dawn carry their own base values so keyframe blending stays exact. Unverified here (no Vulkan in the CPU container); OFF until the GPU lane judges it with --tidewake-look-sections=forward_plus_candidate.

current_flow._comment: F13#5 candidate under this OFF gate. r1: removing the painted rims alone lost the direction read. r2: the lane reads as rougher, darker moving water: standing crests over the lane, a deeper channel tint, bright tapered foam comets, thin chevrons only as a faint secondary hint, and twice the drifting driftwood/kelp with pennant buoys. Flow vectors, strengths and restored state unchanged. r4: chevrons off entirely (judges read every chevron as road paint); foam breaks up more. r5: channel tint back to a faint 0.14 (r4 judges read its hard-edged band as a floating translucent panel). b2 (calibrated batch 1): grouped foam and comets read as an evenly spaced white ladder across the lane; comets 0.35 -> 0.12, chop 0.9 -> 0.6. b2: the installed log floater reads as a grey box; kelp and buoys only until a driftwood asset exists. b3 (calibrated batch 2: road markings FIXED x3 but the lanes no longer read): ungrouped wandering foam ribbons, long and sparse, drifting with the flow; no comets, chevrons or rims; faint tint. b4: kelp floater (a large leaf mesh) read as teal shards and the ribbons were too faint at 0.85/0.7; ribbons at full opacity and density, a little more lane tint; buoys stay. b5 (close-1024, a different approach after b2-b4 lost the read): tide-line seams. An irregular foam seam drifts along both banks where the moving lane meets still sea, small crescent wavelet caps fill the lane, and the ribbon dashes thin to 0.3. b6 (b5 mapped 6.11 vs control 5.64; judges: direction still unclear, straight streaks, no colour shift or chop): seams become foam tongues bright at their downstream heads and fraying upstream, no dashes at all, larger and denser wavelet caps, and a deeper lane tint with a soft wandering edge. r3 (b7 confirming batch: 6.06, direction still the one PRESENT defect; the judges asked for the water itself to say which way): each anchored stake leans 13 degrees downstream and trails a 7 m tapered foam wake from its waterline. Meshy 1024 (tb/meshy-1024 38602bdb0): the drifting floater is a 3.0 m sun-bleached driftwood log (scale 1.58 on its measured 1.9 m) and the stakes are 2.6 m banded spar buoys (scale 1.37 on 1.9 m), replacing the installed log that judges read as a grey box and the small teal marker they read as shards. mc1 (close-1024, confirming batch, r 0.965): the Meshy driftwood and spar buoys scored 5.00/5.06 against r3 5.16 in the same batch, no gain, so the row stays PARKED; and all three judges read r3's stake wakes as stacked translucent vertical glass sheets, an artefact, so the wake is removed (wake_length_m absent) and the stakes keep only their lean. t1 (close-1024 GPU baseline, P2-066 white bars and yellow dashes read as road markings): dashes, comets, chevrons and rims off; softer seams (0.4), smaller wavelet caps jittered, sized and faded per cell so they never form a grid (0.35), faint lane tint. t1b (t1 judges x3: the lane vanishes at night; the pennant buoys read oversized and sharply tilted): foam carries a small moonlit emission (moon_glint 0.12, foam only), and the spar buoys return to their measured 1.9 m at an 8 degree lean. t1c (t1b frames: the loud yellow triangles are the procedural pennant, not the Meshy buoy): a small navy pennant (1.1 x 0.5 m, the buoy brief's colour) on a 1.4 m weathered pole, and moon_glint 0.12 -> 0.3 because 0.12 barely showed. t1d (t1, t2 and t2b judges: the lane reads as a lighter flat slab with straight edges, and foam strokes sit on open water): the flat lane band is off (lane_opacity 0), the channel tint is fainter (0.18 -> 0.12) and the open-water flecks drop (0.25 -> 0.1); the bank seams and wavelet caps carry the lane. t1e (t1d frames: the long straight pale bands are the two bank seams, unbroken from the dock to the horizon): seams break into separate tongues (gap 0.15 -> 0.45), wander more (3 -> 5 m), thinner (1.2 -> 0.9 m) and fainter (0.4 -> 0.3).

One Meshy 1031 focal piece (beach hut, beach bar, fishing shack, market stall, lookout tower, canoe rack; provenance beside each GLB) per non-Veilfall named location, set beside the route line ahead of the spot so the location stand's approach and close views both frame it. Heights against the 1.80 m trainer (hut 5.6 m, bar 4.4 m, shack 4.6 m, stall 3.4 m, tower 9 m, rack 3 m). Each carries a box collider inside its footprint and a grass_clear disc so it stands on clean sand; model-less '_plaza' entries clear loose stones and tufts where the camera looks. Presentation only: no interaction, route, encounter or durable state.
